ayahOccurrences.text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا

ayahOccurrences.text: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: مَرَجَ is in the derivative form: مَرَجَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
م/ر/ج   m–r–j open space, pasture land, to pasture
; to shoot out, branches, to be convoluted, to be obscure; bright, smokeless flame, a bright tongue of fire, to exaggerate; coral; small pearls. The word مَرْجَان marjān, which philologists classify under this root, is an early borrowing into Arabic from Persian, perhaps through Aramaic.

Of this root, 4 forms occur 6 times in the Qur’an:
مَرَجَ maraja 2 times; مَارِج mārij 1 time; مَرِيج marıj 1 time and مَرْجَان marjān 2 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
مَرَجَ maraja u [v. trans.] to cause to flow, to cause to run freely

(55:19) مَرَجَ‏ ‏الْبَحْرَيْنِ‏ ‏يَلْتَقِيَانِ‏ He made the two bodies of [fresh and salt] water flow freely, meeting one another.

entries.label: مَرَجَ
entries.definitionHtml:
مَرَجَ maraja u [v. trans.] to cause to flow, to cause to run freely

(55:19) مَرَجَ‏ ‏الْبَحْرَيْنِ‏ ‏يَلْتَقِيَانِ‏ He made the two bodies of [fresh and salt] water flow freely, meeting one another.

entries.label: مَارِج
entries.definitionHtml:
مَارِج mārij [act. part.] a shooting out [flame of smokeless fire]

(55:15) وَخَلَقَ‏ ‏الْجَانَّ‏ ‏مِنْ‏ ‏مَارِجٍ‏ ‏مِنْ‏ ‏نَارٍ‏ and He created the jinn out of a smokeless flame of fire.

entries.label: مَرِيج
entries.definitionHtml:
مَرِيج marıj [quasi‐act. part.] confusing, obscure

(50:5) بَلْ‏ ‏كَذَّبُوا‏ ‏بِالْحَقِّ‏ ‏لَمَّا‏ ‏جَاءَهُمْ‏ ‏فَهُمْ‏ ‏فِي‏ ‏أَمْرٍ‏ ‏مَرِيجٍ‏ indeed, they denied the truth when it came to them; they are in a state of confusion.

entries.label: مَرْجَان
entries.definitionHtml:
مَرْجَان marjān [n.] coral, also said to mean small pearls

(55:22) يَخْرُجُ‏ ‏مِنْهُمَا‏ ‏اللُّؤْلُؤُ‏ ‏وَالْمَرْجَانُ‏ pearls and coral come forth from both of them.
